headline: Easy Ground Beef Tacos
description: These Ground Beef Tacos are filled with juicy flavorful taco meat made with my homemade taco seasoning - it's an easy weeknight recipe for the whole family!
name: Ground Beef Tacos {Easy 10 Minute Recipe!} - Feel Good Foodie
recipeIngredient: Shredded Mexican cheese blend or cheddar cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the olive oil in skillet over medium high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any fat.

recipeInstructions.text: Add the chili powder, cumin, dried oregano, garlic powder, salt, pepper, tomato paste and water. Stir to combine and continue cooking over medium-low heat until the sauce has thickened, about 3-5 minutes
